assumptions.limitation: Three process pairs provide weak evidence and do not validate normality or global tail probabilities.

completion_regression_gate.reason: This three-block timing design does not establish the separate one-percentage-point completion-regression confidence gate.

definitions.concurrency_throughput: sum(actual tokens in complete two-request windows) / sum(last t_done - common window t_send)
definitions.incomplete_metrics: successful-request/window metrics are descriptive only; incomplete samples cannot pass
definitions.inference_unit: three independent paired process blocks, not individual requests or windows
definitions.memory: declared steady-window peak bytes, with sampled maxima and allocator counters kept separate
definitions.p95: nearest rank ceil(0.95*n), no interpolation; all 60 member request latencies for concurrency-two
definitions.primary_throughput: sum(actual final completion tokens) / sum(request t_done - t_send)
definitions.successful_request: 256 actual completion tokens, final usage, complete transport and valid finish, timing and cache evidence

hardware_scope: Quiet France host with paired stock controls
